description: This file implements the HibernateProviderDAO class, providing database access methods for Provider entities and related objects within the OpenMRS platform, including retrieval, creation, update, delete, and search functionalities.

classes.name: HibernateProviderDAO
classes.description: A concrete implementation of ProviderDAO that uses Hibernate to perform CRUD operations and searches on Provider-related entities in the database.

methods.name: getAllProviders
methods.description: Retrieves all providers, optionally including retired ones.

methods.name: saveProvider
methods.description: Saves or updates a Provider entity in the database.

methods.name: deleteProvider
methods.description: Deletes a specified Provider from the database.

methods.name: getProvider
methods.description: Retrieves a Provider by its integer ID.

methods.name: getProviderByUuid
methods.description: Retrieves a Provider by its UUID.

methods.name: getProvidersByPerson
methods.description: Fetches Providers associated with a specific Person, optionally including retired providers.

methods.name: getProviderAttribute
methods.description: Retrieves a ProviderAttribute by its ID.

methods.name: getProviderAttributeByUuid
methods.description: Retrieves a ProviderAttribute by its UUID.

methods.name: getProviders
methods.description: Searches for Providers by name and attributes, with pagination.

methods.name: getCountOfProviders
methods.description: Returns the count of Providers matching criteria.

methods.name: getAllProviderAttributeTypes
methods.description: Retrieves all ProviderAttributeType entities, optionally including retired ones.

methods.name: getProviderAttributeType
methods.description: Retrieves a ProviderAttributeType by ID.

methods.name: getProviderAttributeTypeByUuid
methods.description: Retrieves a ProviderAttributeType by UUID.

methods.name: getProviderAttributeTypeByName
methods.description: Finds a ProviderAttributeType by its name.

methods.name: saveProviderAttributeType
methods.description: Saves or updates a ProviderAttributeType.

methods.name: deleteProviderAttributeType
methods.description: Deletes a ProviderAttributeType.

methods.name: getProviderByIdentifier
methods.description: Retrieves a Provider by its identifier, ensuring uniqueness.

methods.name: getProviderRole
methods.description: Fetches a ProviderRole by ID.

methods.name: getProviderRoleByUuid
methods.description: Retrieves a ProviderRole by UUID.

methods.name: getProvidersByRoles
methods.description: Retrieves Providers associated with specified roles, with an option to include retired.

methods.name: getAllProviderRoles
methods.description: Lists all ProviderRoles, optionally including retired.

methods.name: saveProviderRole
methods.description: Saves or updates a ProviderRole.

methods.name: deleteProviderRole
methods.description: Deletes a ProviderRole.

methods.name: prepareProviderCriteria
methods.description: Builds search predicates for Provider entities based on name and retirement status.

methods.name: getNameSearchExpression
methods.description: Creates search predicates for person name fields based on a string and match mode.

methods.name: getMatchMode
methods.description: Retrieves the current search match mode configured in global properties.

methods.name: getByUuid
methods.description: Utility method to retrieve an entity by UUID generically.

methods.name: getSession
methods.description: Returns the current Hibernate session.

methods.name: getAll
methods.description: Generic method to retrieve all entities of a given class, with optional retirement filtering and ordering.

methods.name: isProviderIdentifierUnique
methods.description: Checks if a Provider's identifier is unique across the database.
